tool.name: get_connections

lib_path.description: Full lib:// path as it appears in the Qlik script, e.g. 'lib://30_AUTO_Quality\30_Automotive\file.qvd'. The tool extracts the first segment after 'lib://' as the connection name.

fields.description: Response JSON paths only (not downstream arguments). Include answer fields and identifiers/pagination; ['*'] alone intentionally returns full output.

tool.description: Get the data connection for a specific lib:// path in a Qlik Sense app via the Engine API (GetConnections). Strips the 'lib://' prefix, extracts the first path segment (the connection name), calls GetConnections on the document handle, and returns the single connection object whose qName matches that segment. Example: lib_path='lib://30_AUTO_Quality\30_Automotive\file.qvd' → looks up connection with qName='30_AUTO_Quality'.
